source_units.content: When creating the test file, rename it to match the project convention. At the point of writing the test file (line 49), use `frontend/test/metabase/lib/analytics.unit.spec.ts` instead of `analytics.test.ts`. The Jest `testMatch` in `jest.config.js` only discovers `*.unit.spec.{js,jsx,ts,tsx}` files, so `analytics.test.ts` will never be run by `bun run test-unit`.
